Byggeri, tekniske installationer og projektledelse

Virksomhed: DK-Byg ApS

Om stillingen

DK-Byg ApS søger en engageret, ansvarsbevidst og teknisk kompetent projektleder til vores bygge- og entreprenørvirksomhed.

Virksomheden arbejder med forskellige bygge- og renoveringsprojekter, herunder planlægning, koordinering og gennemførelse af tekniske installationer og bygningsrelaterede arbejdsopgaver.

Som teknisk projektleder får du en central rolle i planlægningen og styringen af vores tekniske projektaktiviteter. Du vil have ansvar for koordinering af tekniske installationer, projektopfølgning, kvalitetssikring og samarbejde med håndværkere, teknikere, leverandører og øvrige projektledere.

Stillingen henvender sig særligt til kandidater med en teknisk uddannelse inden for industriel automatisering, instrumentering eller tilsvarende tekniske fagområder, som ønsker at anvende deres tekniske kompetencer inden for bygge- og entreprenørbranchen.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Planlægning og koordinering af tekniske installationer på byggeprojekter.

• 
Projektstyring af ventilationsanlæg, elektriske installationer, styringssystemer og øvrige tekniske bygningsinstallationer.

• 
Udarbejdelse, gennemgang og vedligeholdelse af teknisk dokumentation, tegninger og projektmateriale.

• 
Ansvar for kvalitetssikring, teknisk kontrol og dokumentation af installationer.

• 
Koordinering og ledelse af samarbejdet mellem håndværkere, teknikere, leverandører og projektledere.

• 
Teknisk fejlfinding og opfølgning på installationsarbejde.

• 
Overvågning af projektforløb, tidsplaner og tekniske leverancer.

• 
Sikring af, at tekniske arbejdsopgaver udføres i overensstemmelse med gældende krav og standarder.

• 
Identifikation af forbedringsmuligheder og optimering af tekniske arbejdsprocesser.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du:

• 
Har en teknisk uddannelse som specialiseret tekniker inden for industriel automatisering og instrumentering eller en tilsvarende teknisk uddannelse.

• 
Har god forståelse for tekniske systemer, måleteknik og automatisering.

• 
Har interesse for byggeri, tekniske installationer og projektledelse.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for tekniske projektopgaver.

• 
Har gode organisatoriske og koordinerende evner.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, analytisk og løsningsorienteret.

• 
Har gode samarbejdsevner og kan kommunikere med forskellige faggrupper.

Erfaring fra bygge- og entreprenørbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Der vil blive sørget for nødvendig introduktion til danske byggemetoder, tekniske standarder og virksomhedens arbejdsgange.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

• 
En ansvarsfuld stilling med selvstændige projektlederopgaver.

• 
Mulighed for at anvende og videreudvikle din tekniske uddannelse i praksis.

• 
Introduktion til danske byggemetoder, standarder og tekniske installationer.

• 
Et professionelt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø.

• 
Samarbejde med erfarne medarbejdere og projektledere.

• 
Mulighed for faglig udvikling og øget ansvar.

• 
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Interesserede kandidater bedes sende deres CV og ansøgning med en beskrivelse af relevant uddannelse og teknisk erfaring.

Kontaktperson: Lars Rasmussen
Virksomhed: DK-Byg ApS
CVR-nr.: 44826127
Telefon: +45 93 91 49 89

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Construction, Technical Installations & Project Management

About the Position

DK-Byg ApS is looking for a motivated, responsible, and technically qualified Project Manager to join our construction and contracting company.

Our company works with various construction and renovation projects, including the planning, coordination, and execution of technical installations and building-related activities.

As a Technical Project Manager, you will play a central role in planning, managing, and coordinating our technical project activities. You will be responsible for coordinating technical installations, project follow-ups, quality assurance, and cooperation with construction workers, technicians, suppliers, and other project managers.

This position is particularly suitable for candidates with an educational background in Industrial Automation, Instrumentation, or related technical disciplines who wish to apply their technical knowledge within the construction and contracting industry.

Plan and coordinate technical installations across construction projects.

• 
Manage projects involving ventilation systems, electrical installations, control systems, and other technical building installations.

• 
Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, drawings, and project materials.

• 
Ensure quality assurance, technical inspections, and proper documentation of installations.

• 
Coordinate and manage cooperation between construction workers, technicians, suppliers, and project managers.

• 
Handle technical troubleshooting and follow up on installation work.

• 
Monitor project progress, schedules, and technical deliveries.

• 
Ensure that technical work is carried out in accordance with applicable requirements and standards.

• 
Identify opportunities for improvement and optimize technical workflows and project processes.

Qualifications and Requirements

• 
Hold a technical qualification as a Specialized Technician in Industrial Automation and Instrumentation, or an equivalent technical qualification.

• 
Have a good understanding of technical systems, measurement technology, and automation.

• 
Have an interest in construction, technical installations, and project management.

• 
Are capable of working independently and taking responsibility for technical project activities.

• 
Possess strong organizational and coordination skills.

• 
Work in a structured, analytical, and solution-oriented manner.

• 
Have good communication and cooperation skills when working with different professional groups.

Previous experience in the construction and contracting industry is an advantage but not a requirement.

Relevant introduction and training in Danish construction methods, technical standards, and company procedures will be provided.

What We Offer

• 
A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

• 
A responsible position with independent project management duties.

• 
Opportunities to apply and further develop your technical education in a practical working environment.

• 
Introduction to Danish construction methods, standards, and technical installations.

• 
A professional and collaborative working environment.

• 
Cooperation with experienced employees and project managers.

• 
Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility.

• 
Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and application, including details of their relevant education and technical experience.

Contact Person: Lars Rasmussen
Company: DK-Byg ApS
CVR Number: 44826127
Telephone: +45 93 91 49 89

We look forward to receiving your application.

**Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

**_What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

_**The job

**As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

**Joining the team

**Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

**Your Qualifications

**You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

• excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate confidently and effectively in English

• confidence in presenting to larger audiences, for example at customer visits, conferences or user forums

• an independent, structured work style with the ability to prioritise your own work and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

**Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

**When you join us in Copenhagen, you are not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations – you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering ensures you are always well taken care of. And whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

**Never stop developing

**Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,200 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

**Start your development here

**We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Hans Jørgen Bohlbro, Vice President, Product Management.

Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO

Are you interested in shaping your career in Finance within a global company? Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.
